description: S7 probe: chunk2::pipeline_enabled depends on the second handler answering in its first poll (inline execution). Run in assertion mode against reference-server (expected to fail the same wire assertion) and in diff mode against wdconf --executor worker (expected SAME).

cases.name: pipeline_enabled_second_handler_pending_1ms
cases.source: probe for S7 (worker executor); derived from chunk2::pipeline_enabled
cases.notes: pipeline_enabled with the second reply delayed 1 ms (delay_ms), so the second handler is Pending at its first poll, as every handler is under --executor worker. hyper flushes the first response once the read buffer is empty (io.rs poll_flush with pipeline_flush), so the first read_once gets only the first response and the wire assertions of pipeline_enabled fail for the reference server too. Diff mode: wdconf (inline or worker) must be SAME as the reference.

steps.data:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: example.domain

GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: example.domain
Connection: close

expect.regex:
\AHTTP/1\.1 200 OK
content-length: 12
[^
]*

Hello World
HTTP/1\.1 200 OK
content-length: 12
connection: close
[^
]*

Hello World
